name: Himeka
source: The Empress Chaos' maid and a human. A girl whose real name is unknown and has no memories of her past, aside from remembering that she was about to be kidnapped by a group of men who wanted to experiment on her at one point. However, she was then saved by Chaos, joined their empire and started working as her maid.
